files.html: //! input_pointer_lock - turning a view with the mouse, as a first-person camera does, and what the engine reports //! about the pointer while it does. //! //! A click asks for the pointer lock (`z.disableCursor`). Once the platform grants it, the cursor is hidden and held //! still, and the mouse's own motion keeps coming: `z.getMouseDelta` is how far the hand moved this frame, while the //! position stands still. Summed frame after frame, the motion turns the view - a heading (yaw) and a tilt (pitch), //! in degrees - shown here as a compass strip and a horizon around a crosshair. Escape releases the lock //! (`z.enableCursor`); so does the window losing focus, and in a browser so does the user's own Escape. //! //! The panel shows what the engine knows: whether the lock holds (`z.isPointerLocked`, as the platform last reported //! it), whether the pointer is over the window (`z.isCursorOnScreen`), whether the window has the keyboard's focus //! (`f.window.focused`), the frame's mouse delta, and the position. const std = @import("std"); const Allocator = std.mem.Allocator; const z = @import("zimr"); const common = @import("example_common"); const zm = @import("zm"); const float = zm.float; const Color = zm.Color; const Vec2 = zm.Vec2; const clamp = zm.clamp; const atkinson_mono_ttf = @embedFile("atkinson_mono_ttf"); /// How far the view turns per logical pixel of mouse motion, in degrees. const degrees_per_pixel: f32 = 0.15; /// How many logical pixels on screen one degree of heading or tilt spans. const pixels_per_degree: f32 = 6; /// The tilt stops short of straight up and straight down. const pitch_limit: f32 = 80; const sky: Color = .{ .r = 30, .g = 41, .b = 59, .a = 255 }; const ground: Color = .{ .r = 41, .g = 37, .b = 36, .a = 255 }; const horizon_color: Color = .{ .r = 148, .g = 163, .b = 184, .a = 255 }; const tick_color: Color = .{ .r = 203, .g = 213, .b = 225, .a = 255 }; const crosshair_color: Color = .{ .r = 250, .g = 204, .b = 21, .a = 255 }; const text_color: Color = .{ .r = 226, .g = 232, .b = 240, .a = 255 }; const dim_color: Color = .{ .r = 148, .g = 163, .b = 184, .a = 255 }; const State = struct { font: z.Font, /// The view's heading, in degrees from north, kept in 0..360; and its tilt, positive looking up. yaw: f32 = 0, pitch: f32 = 0, }; fn initState(gpa: Allocator, f: *z.Frame, s: *State) !void { s.* = .{ .font = try z.loadFont(f, gpa, atkinson_mono_ttf, 18) }; } fn deinit(gpa: Allocator, s: *State) void { z.unloadFont(gpa, s.font); } /// The name of a heading that is a multiple of 45 degrees, or null. fn compassName(heading: i32) ?[]const u8 { return switch (@mod(heading, 360)) { 0 => "N", 45 => "NE", 90 => "E", 135 => "SE", 180 => "S", 225 => "SW", 270 => "W", 315 => "NW", else => null, }; } /// The view: ground below the horizon, which rises as the view tilts down; heading ticks every 15 degrees along it, /// sliding as the view turns; and the crosshair at the centre. fn drawView(f: *z.Frame, s: *State, width: f32, height: f32) void { const center_x: f32 = width / 2; const center_y: f32 = height / 2; const horizon_y: f32 = center_y + s.pitch * pixels_per_degree; f.gl.rect(.{ .x = 0, .y = 0, .width = width, .height = height }, .{ .color = sky }); if (horizon_y < height) { const ground_top: f32 = @max(horizon_y, 0); f.gl.rect(.{ .x = 0, .y = ground_top, .width = width, .height = height - ground_top }, .{ .color = ground }); } f.gl.rect(.{ .x = 0, .y = horizon_y - 1, .width = width, .height = 2 }, .{ .color = horizon_color }); // The headings in view, every 15 degrees: a heading `h` sits (h - yaw) degrees right of the centre. const half_span: f32 = width / 2 / pixels_per_degree; const first_step: i32 = @floor((s.yaw - half_span) / 15); const last_step: i32 = @ceil((s.yaw + half_span) / 15); var step: i32 = first_step; while (step <= last_step) : (step += 1) { const heading: i32 = step * 15; const x: f32 = center_x + (float(heading) - s.yaw) * pixels_per_degree; const name: ?[]const u8 = compassName(heading); const tick_height: f32 = if (name != null) 24 else 12; const tick: z.Rectangle = .{ .x = x - 1, .y = horizon_y - tick_height, .width = 2, .height = tick_height }; f.gl.rect(tick, .{ .color = tick_color }); if (name) |label| { const label_position: [2]f32 = .{ x - 6, horizon_y - tick_height - 24 }; f.gl.text(label_position, label, .{ .size = 18, .color = tick_color, .font = &s.font }); } } f.gl.rect(.{ .x = center_x - 12, .y = center_y - 1, .width = 24, .height = 2 }, .{ .color = crosshair_color }); f.gl.rect(.{ .x = center_x - 1, .y = center_y - 12, .width = 2, .height = 24 }, .{ .color = crosshair_color }); } /// One line of the panel: a label and its value. fn panelLine( f: *z.Frame, s: *State, row: usize, label: []const u8, value: []const u8, ) void { const y: f32 = 44 + float(row) * 24; f.gl.text(.{ 16, y }, label, .{ .size = 16, .color = dim_color, .font = &s.font }); f.gl.text(.{ 250, y }, value, .{ .size = 16, .color = text_color, .font = &s.font }); } fn update(f: *z.Frame, s: *State) void { const is_locked: bool = z.isPointerLocked(f.input); if (!is_locked and z.isMouseButtonPressed(f.input, .left)) { z.disableCursor(f.input); } if (is_locked and z.isKeyPressed(f.input, .escape)) { z.enableCursor(f.input); } const delta: Vec2 = z.getMouseDelta(f.input); if (is_locked) { // Moving the mouse right turns the view right; moving it forward, away from the hand, tilts the view up. s.yaw = @mod(s.yaw + delta[0] * degrees_per_pixel, 360); s.pitch = clamp(s.pitch - delta[1] * degrees_per_pixel, -pitch_limit, pitch_limit); } const width: f32 = f.window.widthf(); const height: f32 = f.window.heightf(); drawView(f, s, width, height); const lock_text: []const u8 = if (is_locked) "held - Escape releases it" else "not held - click to lock"; panelLine(f, s, 0, "pointer lock", lock_text); panelLine(f, s, 1, "pointer over the window", if (z.isCursorOnScreen(f.input)) "yes" else "no"); panelLine(f, s, 2, "window has focus", if (f.window.focused) "yes" else "no"); const delta_text: z.Str(48) = .print("{d:.1}, {d:.1}", .{ delta[0], delta[1] }); panelLine(f, s, 3, "mouse delta this frame", delta_text.slice()); const position: Vec2 = z.getMousePosition(f.input); const position_text: z.Str(48) = .print("{d:.0}, {d:.0}", .{ position[0], position[1] }); panelLine(f, s, 4, "mouse position", position_text.slice()); const view_text: z.Str(48) = .print("heading {d:.0}, tilt {d:.0}", .{ s.yaw, s.pitch }); panelLine(f, s, 5, "view", view_text.slice()); common.caption(f.gl, s.font, "input_pointer_lock: click to lock the pointer, move to turn, Escape to release"); } pub const app: z.AppSpec(State) = .{ .config = .{ .window = .{ .title = "zimr - core - input pointer lock", .width = 900, .height = 600, .scale_mode = .responsive, }, }, .init = initState, .memory = .managed, .deinit = deinit, .update = update, };
